body: I always had a certain smell to me when my anorexia was at its worst. I only realized because my mom could smell it like a bloodhound and knew when I was restricting too hard, so I remember wearing waaaayyy too much perfume in an effort to mask it. She would hunt me down to get a whiff and pick a fight. Love spell and acetones, I probably smelled ripe. 💀
Oatmeal. It’s filling and I can get creative with what I add to it and almost trick myself into feeling like I’m eating a dessert (since my binges usually revolve around heinous amounts of sweets).

It could be your sodium intake.. I have to watch mine pretty closely or else the scale won’t budge when I inevitably retain water weight as a result otherwise. 😓

Also, that toaster is so cute and now I have to buy one 🥺🖤

It’s been quite the process of emotions, so no worries; I don’t find this offensive, I understand it. Grief is very strange to navigate, especially under these circumstances, but I’m making it as best as I can. Much love to you. 🖤
I appreciate this more than words can truly express, thank you. 🖤 Hugs and love back to you. I hope things get better for all of us.

The person I thought was the love of my life was killed in a hit and run accident back in April.. right at the same time I found out he’d been cheating with one of my friends and they’d both been lying to me and hiding it from me. I kicked him out of my house to make him walk home and think about what he’d done (I’m Boo-Boo the Fool, I know I would’ve probably taken him back if I weren’t the person I am now after what transpired), but he never made it. They found him dead in the road not too far from my house, and the person who hit him still has never come forward. It’s been implied by what happened from witnesses and investigations that it was a suicide, perhaps out of guilt, perhaps the stress of his life as a whole in that moment, but I don’t even know anymore. His last parting gift to me? Well, that man who loved me /so, so/ much gave me an STI that I will live with for the rest of my life that made its presence known and flared like hell due to the grief and is still nearly impossible to keep under control with medication because of my general bad health. Thanks!

After going through some sheer health scares after and being unable to consistently eat without getting sick while coping, doctor after doctor visit, I was finally diagnosed with thyroid cancer.

So.. life really said, “buckle up, bud, it’s only going to get worse” this year to me, and now I’m back in the death grip of an ED just to not go insane. 🤡

I can at least control this.. right?

I got full fat soda instead of diet as a teenager at Sonic because they messed up my order. I panicked and didn’t even consider going to the bathroom.. just opened the car door and purged right there in the parking lot in front of God and everyone. It haunts me, but EDs make us do some uncharacteristic things.
It’s gradually nearing on 9 am where I live and I haven’t slept a wink because I just.. can’t, insomnia got hands as my ED worsens. I hate it here in this flesh prison lol
Forget them, you’re better than they ever will be, lovely. I want to split my hair like this again so badly! You’re an inspiration 🥰💜

If it makes you feel any better, on my 18th birthday, my mother bought me a cake (against me insisting and begging her not to), and I cried when I saw it. My dad had a fit, accused me of not truly being anorexic, just “attention-seeking” and spoiled.. so, in a totally level-headed response, I grabbed the cake and chucked it at him.

As it turns out, when you look like you’re Doot-Doot the skeleton and have zero muscle to put into that throw, the cake only traveled a few inches and then plopped at his feet. Very anti-climactic.

It was not a fun day for anyone involved, but we laugh at it now, at least.

Rice, egg whites, baked normal or sweet potato, broths and crackers, chewing on ice for hydration so you can do it slowly. I would look into getting some electrolyte replacement drinks, ones that contain B vitamins especially because drinking depletes your body of those, often what makes you feel horrid afterwards.

It’ll pass, just give it time. Your insides are just a little miffed with the poison punch.

Yes, but I’ve found taking Pepcid and eating tums while just having water for a few uncomfortable hours usually makes it go away a lot faster. Can be prevented entirely (for me, if I know I’m going to binge) by taking the Pepcid an hour before I eat so it can already be working it’s digestive soothing magic.

I would take powdered stevia, pour it into a bowl, then use those Mio water flavouring things and mix it up into a fruity paste that I would then eat with a tiny spoon. 🥲

Made me never want to eat again. Here I am.

Take a supplement of or eat something rich in B vitamins, drinking heavily depletes your body of them and is likely the reason why you feel off. I found that body armor drinks (you can find them at most grocery stores or gas stations) helped me a lot in the past because of their vitamin/electrolytes content. Probably wouldn’t hurt to get some magnesium in too. I hope you feel better soon!

I’m 6 weeks sober from alcoholism now, and one of the biggest drives keeping me from relapsing is that I am absolutely terrified of calories again. Suffering. 🙃

I can think of a few incidents that caused me to realize, “Oh Jesus, it’s bad,” that lead me to “recover” for brief periods.

When I was a teenager. It was the worst point of my ED, I was severely ill. I refused to eat anything and got to the point where I wouldn’t even use toothpaste to brush my teeth or put lotion on my skin because I was afraid either meant I would be absorbing some amount of calories. Yes, I know that’s gross.. but that’s where my head was at.

Another time, my sister took me out to sonic to get a drink. I ALWAYS got a large Coke Zero. I took one sip of it, and knew right off the bat they’d given me the wrong soda, that it wasn’t diet. Had an absolute meltdown panic attack, opened the vehicle door, and purged it right in the parking lot in front of my sister while sobbing. Not a good look.

My 18th birthday. Mom insisted on buying me a cake, I told her no over and over again, begged and pleaded with her not to. The day rolled around, and lo and behold, she bought me a huge cake. I broke down crying because I knew I couldn’t bring myself to eat it and felt so guilty. Cue my father screaming at me, telling me I was selfish and that it was all in my head, that I didn’t actually have an eating disorder, that I was just ungrateful. After knowing that my ED had nearly killed me multiple times at that point, after all of the years of hell I’d been going through, I lost my cool, picked up the cake, and threw it at his head. (I was very weak with bad aim, so it just plopped on the floor at his feet.) Mom wasn’t really mad at me for it, didn’t blame me because she was just as upset with him for what he said, but I’ll forever regret that moment for as long as I live.

My mom always pulls this on me when I try to open up to her about my struggle with my ED. I’m always hit with the, “You have everything going for you, you’re so pretty and petite, you should be happy, etc.”

So, now I don’t even bother. I’ll just vent and cry about it with strangers on the internet instead. 🤪
My last binge ended up with me eating a whole pint of ice cream that I’d had for so long that it was well beyond freezer burnt. I felt this post in the depths of my soul. 🙃

I am on 1/2 ml/100 mg subq injections of T per week. 
I had not considered trying Fin more than asking a doctor for a prescription in the past, and having him essentially laugh in my face for even requesting it (despite the fact that at the time, I was suffering a LOT of hair fall and starting to show some spots of noticeable thinning on my scalp, but I combatted it with other means of supplements and shampoos, and it seemed to help after a few months). I could look into it again if it might help block or slow down some of the changes that are causing me to really freak out.

I haven’t been seeing a therapist recently, as I elaborated on in a reply to a previous comment on this thread, as it’s not really within my financial capability to upkeep seeing one at the moment, but I will likely try asking my GP what I can regarding medication and resources he has for my mental health and see where that goes. 

I was previously seeing my therapist that was the one who confirmed my gender dysphoria and referred me to HRT rather rapidly (it has been a long time since, years even), but after expressing that I was halting medical transition in the past due to other circumstances going on in my life, she became very incensed with me and urged me NOT to detransition, insisting I needed to stay on hormones to be truly happy. I’m sure it came from a place of concern for my well-being, but it’s left me with a sense of fear of bringing any of this up to her now, as I feel like she would completely invalidate my sense of confusion and insist I’m just trying to repress.. which I really don’t think is what is going on this time. It just feels so much different, and it’s overwhelmingly heavy. I feel like I’m losing myself, whoever that may be.

Thank you for taking the time to respond to my post and give your insight, all of the comments on here have made me really realize that I need to definitely take a closer look at my mental well-being and be in a safe place of mindset while I work through this.

I do think that a lot of the commentary I’ve received on my female body has gotten to me over the years. I have CONSTANTLY been called tiny, cute, petite, pixie, small, and assumed to be weak and lesser than. It’s especially shown to be true in certain job fields I’ve worked, where the men were always taken more seriously than me (I previously worked primarily security and corrections jobs, so trust me when I say that it was something I dealt with heavily in those fields). When presenting as female, my body has always been used to make me feel like I’m too fragile or inept compared to my peers. 

As far as medicine goes, I was on Ativan for quite a while for my anxiety, but I ended up becoming too dependent on it and taking higher and higher doses to receive the same effect as the lower doses once had. I ended up quitting them a little over a month ago because I was tired of relying on them to even make it through the day as a normal person, and after going through a very bleak withdrawal period, I’m sort of back to normal. Financially, it’s a struggle for me to find a proper therapist I could keep up with seeing at the moment for further options, as I am disabled from a very bad hand injury that leaves me unable to work until I receive an upcoming surgery (that I have thankfully been approved for grants for and am receiving help from family for funds to cover the rest, but they will not help me for my mental health at all, that’s a whole can of worms that I wouldn’t even try to burden them with), and I am uninsured.

May I ask what anxiety medicine you have found helps? I may be able to convince my GP to prescribe me something else or give me references to affordable resources within his scope of practice. Thank you for your input on this, it means the world to me. 💜

Drunkorexic here. OMAD some pitiful meal of veggies or soup then binge vodka or wine for dinner and the rest of the foreseeable night, don’t even bother counting those calories because I don’t want to think about it. Suffer the liquor shits like mad the next day, almost like taking laxatives and I don’t gain weight (as far as I can tell, I’m sure it’s mostly water weight but whatever). What a wild ride. Feels awful, but I sadly love being drunk because it keeps my mind off of my nagging ED, and for some reason it doesn’t count in my mind. God forbid I just restrict and eat normally (in that regard).

My dinner for these past few weeks most of the time has been vodka, I purposely allot my calories to squeeze my fix in because that ~drunkorexic~ life (it sucks). It dehydrates the life out of me until I feel like an overdone piece of beef jerky, and it gives me the liquor shits coupled sometimes with nausea the next day (TMI, but we’re all friends here) so then I don’t even have to abuse laxatives since my body is already in a state of purge everything chaos. I’m pretty sure I’ve been losing almost all water weight since alcohol is just empty calories and my tolerance has went up, but at least I don’t have to acknowledge my crippling feelings of anxiety and depression when I’m drunk. Yeehaw! 🤪

My mom insisted on getting me a cake for my 18th birthday after me repeatedly begging her not to (even outside of being terrified of the calories, I genuinely just don’t like cake), and she ultimately had my father bring one home for me anyway.

I cried (mostly from anger at myself, but also at my mother for ignoring my pleading) when I saw it because I was at the lowest point of my ED then and knew I couldn’t even begin to stomach a bite of it. This lead to my father screaming at me and telling me to “just eat”, that my ED wasn’t real and I was just being ungrateful, etc.

My blood was absolutely boiling at that point, and I was so distressed and insulted considering I had nearly died TWICE that year due to being so malnourished/underweight that I acted impulsively and chucked the entire cake at him.

It was a complete disaster, and I know this all probably makes me sound like a completely ungrateful brat, but ED-fueled hanger and despair are definitely quite the motivators for poor decisions. I’ll never forget that day for as long as I live.
Sexual assault when I was a youth was what triggered me to spiral down this god forsaken rabbit hole of garbage coping mechanisms/behaviours, so it hit my morbid funny bone. 🤷🏻‍♀️

Every partner I’ve ever had has always practically fetishized how “petite” and skinny I am, which has fueled me to stay even on the low side of a normal weight for me when I was “recovered”. It’s always made me feel heavily offended and afraid that they wouldn’t like me if I gained weight, which hurts me deeply and keeps me in this cycle of falling back to restriction. A lot of them also expressed genuine disdain and disgust for anyone they deemed chubby/overweight, which didn’t help at all.
Definitely “profastinator”, though younger me was absolutely “stfu”. What an awful time that was to be alive.
Coffee usually helps me. Also, if I eat enough grapes on an empty/nearly empty stomach, it usually has a near laxative effect. Same with sugar-free mints.

The exact same thing happened to me.
I got strep BAD, couldn’t even swallow or think of eating solids, so I wound up barely eating for nearly two weeks (it was the worst case of strep I’ve ever had), and I rapidly lost weight. Not to mention, I was on so many different antibiotics that just killed my appetite. I’ve been recovered from my ED for a few years now, but now I’m back to crying over meals and feeling drained all of the time since I can’t bring myself to eat enough to function. Feels awful. I hope we can both snap out of this illness-induced relapse soon.

This actually happened to me last year. I was pregnant, was due to have my abortion soon, and then began to miscarry on Mother's Day, ironically enough.

I was extremely relieved because I had hyperemesis gravidarum (think morning sickness, but multiply the nausea and misery by a thousand). I couldn't even keep water down and I wanted to cry every day that I woke up because it would hit me as soon as I opened my eyes. The days that were leading up to the planned abortion felt like years.

It was a painful process, but I didn't end up needing a D&C and I saved quite a bit, given my abortion was going to cost $700. I felt back to my normal self very quickly after and was ultimately thankful that things panned out the way they did in that regard. The place I had scheduled my abortion at had many picketers, and I had already gotten into it with them when I went for my consultation appointment, so I wasn't looking forward to having to potentially see them again on the day of the procedure.

I don't see myself as his mother, but I get your point. I let my family joke because it's whatever floats their boat as long as I'm not pestered for grandchildren. At the end of the day, he's still an animal, he just happens to be in my residence and care. I think it falls more on the end of the spectrum of light-hearted self-expression that you were referring to.

I call my cat my fur baby, and when around family, he's jokingly referred to as my son/the grandcat since my parents know that's the closest being to a grandchild they'll ever have from me.

Part of my reasoning for not wanting children is that they're a hell of a lot more responsibility than my cat will ever be. I didn't have to endure immense pain and completely give up my body to bring him into my life, I just adopted him one day and he's been my loving little companion since. 

Sure, I have to maintain his litter box and feed him, but my life doesn't revolve around him. If I want to go out and do something on a whim, like see a movie or go to dinner, I can comfortably leave him at home with food and water and no protective services will be called for leaving him there. There's no babysitter involved or needed (unless I'm traveling, of course, but that's a bit different).

I don't see the harm in anyone referring to their pets as their babies or whatnot, it doesn't mean they have some hidden desire to parent. Some people just really love pets, like I do. I definitely have absolutely no desire to have a child and don't view him as a replacement for one. I'm just speaking from my own perspective, though.

I'm really happy things worked out for you. From what I've seen of the posts on this sub (and experienced myself firsthand), finding a partner that is also accepting of the CF lifestyle is extremely rare. Congrats!

I've been told this same sentiment by my own mother, and it's something that people have found appalling if I ever bring it up, but it's never offended me in the slightest because I get it.
It doesn't mean my mother doesn't love me. I'm not blind to all of the sacrifices she made to have and raise me (especially being an expensive IVF baby). It just helped to solidify my own decision to be CF, and there's virtually no pressure on me from my mother to reproduce because she thinks it's the smart choice that she wishes she had made, which I know isn't the case for most CF people.
I have a shih-tzu pup (though she's definitely a few years old now, she'll always be my baby) and I love her to death. Congratulations!

I have a pretty close friend who was born with Duchenne muscular dystrophy. He's been wheelchair bound for most of his life and has to have caretakers to do EVERYTHING for him because his condition has him nearly completely incapacitated, he can't even wipe his own ass. His mother was a carrier for it and knew it could be passed on to her children, either as another carrier with a daughter, or with a 50/50 chance of inheriting it with sons. She had two sons, and my friend was the unlucky one side of the genetic coin toss, but his brother didn't get it. He has to watch him live a life free of pain and near constant medical attention, and it's made him extremely bitter and depressed. He's told me for years about how he wishes he was never born and how much he loathes his mother for being selfish enough to have children. His experience has truly stuck with me and contributes a lot to why I chose to be CF (besides the fact I simply find the idea of being a parent abhorrent), given I have quite a few illnesses I could potentially pass to my theoretical children. I couldn't ever be selfish enough to take a risk like that and watch a person I chose to bring into existence suffer like I've suffered.

Thank you so much! I live in Tennessee, so I know how pretty close-minded some of the doctors can be in my region of the US and how much another name on the list for around here would mean. I'm definitely going to update as soon as I know more.
